svg.aria-label: Capability stack. L6 Medical imaging AI: 3D volumetric segmentation, multi-sequence MRI, 2.5D slice modelling, lesion-wise evaluation, weakly supervised learning, ECG signal analysis, DICOM / NIfTI processing, SimpleITK, nnU-Net v2. L5 Research methods: experimental design, ablation studies, leakage-free data splitting, external validation, bootstrap confidence intervals, multi-seed reporting, failure-mode analysis, scientific writing, peer review. L4 LLMs and agents: transformer fine-tuning, medical LLMs, LLM information extraction, structured JSON outputs, prompt engineering, quantized inference (GGUF), local LLM serving (Ollama), Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic tool use. L3 Deep learning: PyTorch, CNNs (ResNet, ConvNeXt), vision transformers, attention pooling, graph neural networks, PyTorch Geometric, transfer learning, loss design for class imbalance. L2 Machine learning: scikit-learn, gradient boosting, probability calibration, conformal prediction, uncertainty quantification, applicability domain, soft-label learning, cheminformatics (RDKit). L1 Systems and MLOps: Linux, shell scripting, Docker, CUDA GPU training, cloud compute (GCP), remote GPU instances, Git, CLI / API packaging, GitHub Actions.
svg.text: Capability stack, from hardware to clinic
